question: Which of the following cloning vectors can transport more DNA fragments ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Phages -> can transport larger DNA fragments compared to plasmids -> higher DNA carrying capacity -> 80% CHAIN: Plasmids -> have limited capacity for DNA fragments -> can transport smaller DNA fragments -> 70% CHAIN: YACs (yeast artificial chromosomes) -> can transport very large DNA fragments -> high DNA carrying capacity -> 90% CHAIN: Cosmids -> can transport larger DNA fragments compared to plasmids -> higher DNA carrying capacity -> 80%
analysis: YACs (yeast artificial chromosomes) can transport more DNA fragments compared to phages, plasmids, and cosmids due to their larger size and ability to accommodate larger DNA inserts.
